capabilities: Search note names, full text, tags, properties, bookmarks and internal or external links
Search commands and the web from the same bar
Embed one or more search bars in a note with a fenced block
Save filters as reusable presets using glob, regex and path rules
Move a floating search into a full search page keeping query and filters
disambiguation: Not a graph or visualization tool; it is a search bar for vault content, commands and the web.
extras: Plugin controls are currently in Chinese, and the README is a translated guide to the labels. Global and internet modes can send input to enabled search engines' suggestion endpoints unless those are disabled. Settings are stored in data.json and history in a history/ folder; the content index is kept in memory and can be rebuilt by command.
problem: Vault search, command lookup and web lookups are separate in Obsidian, and there is no floating or embeddable search bar that indexes Chinese text.
summary: Unified search bar that finds note names, full text, tags, properties, links, commands and web results, with CJK text indexing.
